acceptance_criteria.statement: A human-authored review action identifies the human actor.
A review action performed by an AI on a human's behalf identifies both the AI and the human principal.

content.statement: As a review participant, I can see whether an action came from a human or an AI acting on a human's behalf so its authority and provenance are clear.
content.title: Understand review-action provenance

state.reason: Confirmed during the initial product interview.
